summary: NextNRG, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 13, 2026, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor to issue up to 3,000,000 shares of new Series C Convertible Non-Voting Preferred Stock for $27.2 million. At the initial closing, 1,000,000 shares were sold for $9.2 million, partially via cancellation of a $2.0 million promissory note. The preferred stock converts into common stock, subject to conditions including stockholder approval and registration statement effectiveness. Although this is an equity financing, it involves a convertible instrument that may affect capital structure; however, no special-situation category matches precisely, so this is classified conservatively as None.
